graph.title: Bricktober Pizza Place (40181)
notes: The L3 'three separate groups' warning is not a real problem for this manual, so I kept the three groups unconnected. The booklet builds three independent models: the pizza place (b1-b112, pages 3-17), the white delivery van (b113-b127, pages 18-19) and the dark-brown car (b128-b139, pages 20-21). Each vehicle is built on its own with its own step numbering, starting again from step 1. Page 22 shows the finished vehicles parked beside the building, with no step that fastens them to it. Adding joined or contact edges would invent connections the manual doesn't have.

The manual's element numbers differ from the supplied parts list, and some icons can't be told apart (clear vs white 1x2 plates, white vs clear 1x1 plates). I assigned colours from the parts list counts and from where each piece is used in the steps. The six 1x2 plates in the vehicles are split as 3 white (van base, car base, car top) and 3 clear (van body).
Pavement (steps 4-5): the 6x8 base plate has a 6-wide, 5-deep frame at the back and a 3x6 pavement at the front. I attached every pavement piece (b9-b23) directly to the base plate b1.

From step 6 on, I inferred which specific stud or piece supports another one from the isometric pictures. The pieces and the order are certain. The exact stud-to-stud choices are approximate. This mostly affects the awning curves, the roof plates, the masonry stacks and the red/clear 1x1 stacks.
Step 10: I read the 1x1 clear plate as sitting on a clear 1x1 brick, with the white tooth plate on top of the plate.
Step 12: the barrel is silver plate, silver plate, then silver round tile, all on the green 1x1 plate b22.

Vehicle wheels: the 1x1 clip plates sit on the base 1x2 plate's studs, and the next 1x2 plate goes on top of them. The four black round plates are shown clipped to the two clip plates, two wheels per clip plate. Their ports are approximate (6141 stud into 4081b clip), and the wheels are marked revolute.
The pin joins in step 8 use pin.1 into pin-hole.1 of each Technic brick. The pin goes into one hole and sticks out of the brick.
The pizza sign (b110) is joined to the red 1x2 side-stud brick (b100) with one edge. The umbrella dish (b112) sits on the torch support (b111), which is on the middle stud of green plate b23.
